task.title: Preserve continuity in focused Conversations
task.source: Live Harlequin transcript and saved generation prompt snapshots

coreClaim: Long focused Conversations keep the newest five transcript messages, including the assistant answers needed to interpret user follow-ups, without changing shorter chats or sibling modes.
rootCause: The long-Conversation focus policy activated after twenty assistant replies and deliberately removed every assistant message from recent history, merging several user follow-ups into a causally incomplete provider prompt.

inScope: Explicitly targeted long group-Conversation prompt history
Focused prompt assembly contract and design documentation
outOfScope: Conversation focus activation threshold or prompt budgets
Roleplay, Visual Novel, Game, impersonation, or untargeted group behavior

claimBoundary.coreClaim: Once Conversation focus activates, its bounded tail preserves the actual newest five visible transcript messages rather than deleting the assistant side of the dialogue.
currentPathsOrFormats: Focused single-character Conversation generation after twenty visible assistant replies.
Focused explicitly targeted group-Conversation generation after twenty visible assistant replies.
The shared history selector remains capped at five messages and preserves existing images and assistant provider metadata.
outOfScopeClaims: This change does not promise that every generated reply will be stylistically perfect.
This change does not enlarge history beyond five messages.
This change does not alter stored transcripts or memories.

contractLaneGate.brokenContract: Recent user follow-ups reached the model without the assistant statements they referred to.
contractLaneGate.impliedContract: A bounded Conversation history must still preserve enough turn causality for the newest user message to be interpreted.
contractLaneGate.actualEnforcement: The Conversation-owned focus policy now includes assistant history while retaining the existing five-message cap.
contractLaneGate.primaryOwnerDetail: Conversation prompt-focus policy is owned by the TypeScript engine generation layer.
contractLaneGate.wrongLaneFixToAvoid: Do not patch the UI, change the provider, enlarge all mode histories, or inject a fallback explanation into the prompt.
regressionProof: The Harlequin-shaped follow-up test fails under user-only history and passes when the two immediately preceding assistant replies are preserved.
Focused single and targeted-group tests assert the five-message user/assistant/user/assistant/user tail.
Short Conversation, impersonation, untargeted group, Roleplay, and Game negative controls pass.

riskClaimMatrix.coreClaim: Focused Conversation prompts preserve recent causal turn pairs within the existing five-message budget.
positiveRowsTested: explicitly targeted group focus at twenty replies

groundTruthFacts.description: The live saved prompt contained five user messages and no intervening Harlequin replies after the focus threshold.
groundTruthFacts.evidence: The Pi's saved generation snapshot for the affected Harlequin reply showed the five user messages with no assistant turns.

groundTruthFacts.description: The provider remained NanoGPT GLM-5.2 and completed normally, isolating prompt assembly as the broken boundary.
groundTruthFacts.evidence: The same saved generation snapshot recorded NanoGPT GLM-5.2 and a normal stop finish reason.

positiveRows.claim: The newest assistant replies remain in the focused provider history.
positiveRows.evidence: prompt-assembly.conversation-focus.spec.ts asserts an exact user/assistant/user/assistant/user role sequence and both causal assistant statements.

positiveRows.claim: The prompt remains bounded and character-focused.
positiveRows.evidence: The focused spec retains the five-message cap, compact character sentinels, voice examples, memory command contract, and prompt-size ceiling.

positiveRows.claim: Shared generation and repository contracts remain valid.
positiveRows.evidence: Sixty-three focused generation tests and pnpm check exited 0, including TypeScript, architecture, docs, security, frontend, and Rust workspace checks.

contradictionRows.claim: The correction must not activate in short Conversation chats.
contradictionRows.evidence: The nineteen-reply negative control retains the normal forty-one-message prompt path.

contradictionRows.claim: Sibling modes and excluded Conversation paths must remain unchanged.
contradictionRows.evidence: Impersonation, untargeted group Conversation, Roleplay, and Game tests all pass.

contradictionRows.claim: The repair must not restore unbounded assistant self-imitation.
contradictionRows.evidence: The focused history remains capped at exactly five visible transcript messages.

untestedRows: No message was sent into the user's live Harlequin chat during verification.
Post-merge Pi deployment verification is pending the exact merged image.

ownedFacts.description: The bug begins when focused history activates at twenty assistant replies.
ownedFacts.evidence: The saved Harlequin transcript crossed reply twenty immediately before the user-only prompt policy appeared in generation snapshots.

ownedFacts.description: The corrected provider history contains the two newest assistant answers within the five-message tail.
ownedFacts.evidence: The public prompt-assembly integration spec verifies exact roles and content.

manualBlockers.reason: The deterministic prompt boundary is directly tested, and writing a synthetic message into the user's private live chat would be destructive verification.

verification.baselineEvidence: The regression first failed with only user/user history, then eight focused tests, sixty-three neighboring generation tests, and pnpm check passed after the owner fix.
